scenes.heading: Picking one channel before spreading thin

sents.d: Picking one channel before spreading thin
Master one platform before adding a second.
Trying to post on every platform at once usually means being mediocre everywhere instead of strong somewhere.
Pick the one platform where your target audience already spends time, and commit to learning its specific format and algorithm before expanding.

scenes.heading: Give one channel a few months

sents.d: Give a single channel at least a few months of consistent effort before judging results — most growth compounds slowly and inconsistently at first.
Only add a second platform once the first is producing steady results, and even then, consider repurposing content rather than creating entirely separate content for each channel.

take: Win one channel before adding another.
